purpose: The Product Owner's S8B-01 CP2 Google Cloud PayGo verification (2026-10-28): a bounded check of access, billing, capacity and first-audio latency for the two Gemini TTS models through Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform). It is not a CP2 re-run: CP2's approval is CONSUMED and its samples are not repeated.

guard.credentialNote: An OAuth access token from Application Default Credentials (gcloud auth application-default print-access-token), obtained by the launcher into memory only and passed to the guarded child; never printed, logged or written. No API key, no service-account key, no new project or billing account.

api.method: streamGenerateContent (Server-Sent Events); responseModalities AUDIO; the text verbatim; no style; no systemInstruction, temperature, topP, topK or candidateCount

pricingNote: Google Cloud pricing through 2026-12-31 is promotional, 'provided through 50% credits back on net spend'; how that is billed is not verified, so every reservation and the reported upper estimate use the list price (from 2027-01-01).
text: أهلًا بيك، أنا معاك. قولّي يومك كان عامل إيه؟
textNote: Invented for this check, not a CP2 corpus item; no user data.
measures: time to the end of the stream
estimated cost at the promotional and the list price
notMeasured: Capacity: two calls prove nothing about throughput; capacity is assessed from Google's documentation or Google's confirmation, never by a load test.
